newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends down on overseas sales.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends down on overseas sales.

text.p: Hong Kong gold ended down on Wednesday from its previous New York close on overseas selling, bullion dealers said.

"There was selling from traders in Japan," said one dealer. Other gold sources reported afternoon selling from London. Bullion ended at US$357.80/358.30 an ounce on Wednesday against New York's US$358.60/359.10 close on Tuesday.
Dealers saw gold heading further south, with support pegged at between $354-356 per ounce.
A senior bullion manager said the drop in COMEX open interest indicated much of the shortcovering was over.
"I think the funds will start selling again," he said.
Physical gold sales had picked up slightly with the drop in spot prices, but activity was slow, dealers said.
Local gold ended at HK$37 lower at HK$3,316 a tael.
The carryover charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society rose to +5.00 from its previous fix at +4.00
